meta/rules.text:
Three of us, each with a Claude agent. Specs live in docs/ of each repository; the board points at them.
1. Who owns what
- Ana: the app (pocket-pantry/app). Ben: the API (pocket-pantry/api). Cy: design, in the app repo under design/.
- Touching the other repo: ask its owner in the task thread first.
2. Branches and merges
- One branch per task, named after its key (v1-6-shopping-list). A person merges; agents open PRs only.
- API contract changes (api/openapi.yaml) need a notice the day they merge.
3. Announce
- Contract changes, new environment variables, anything that breaks a local setup.
